_comment: Your own changes to skills, applied over the game data when the server starts (restart after editing). Key: skill id (the Grimoire's skill search shows ids). All fields are optional: damageMultiplier scales damage (or healing) at every rank; ranks sets exact numbers for single ranks, numbered as in game (1 = the first rank), with initial and base as in the skill formula ceil(base + initial x (1 + sqrt(ability / 100) + sqrt(stat / divisor))); cooldown (seconds), energy and castTime set every rank. name is only a label for you. The PvP version of a skill gets the same changes. Entries starting with _ are ignored, so remove the _ to switch an example on. Damage over time (Rupture's bleed, poisons, burns) is the skill's status effect, set with dotMultiplier (scales every rank's per-tick amount), dotRanks (exact amount and base for single ranks: per tick = ceil(base + amount x (1 + sqrt(ability / 100) + sqrt(stat / divisor)))), dotDuration (seconds) and dotTick (seconds between ticks; most tick every 5). The same status-effect fields also work under effect… names (effectMultiplier, effectRanks, effectDuration) for buffs and debuffs that aren't damage over time, e.g. how much skill evasion Bless gives. castWithWeaponDelay: true makes the cast take the weapon's attack delay (with haste) on top of its own cast time, landing at its end; the client's casting circle shows the same (client patch P18, whose skill list must match).

214.name: Rupture (owner, 2026-10-16: bleed ticks at full strength as on live, 23.23 + 11.85 x (1 + sqrt(Strength/10) + sqrt(Melee Combat/100)) at rank 50, every second, 10 ticks: the first on the hit (owner's rule 2026-10-16), then at 1-9 s (9.5 so the last lands before it ends); the game's own 14 s cooldown)

_223.name: Bless (all skill evasions; rank 50 gives ceil(base + amount x (1 + sqrt(Nature Magic / 100) + sqrt(stat / divisor)))). Remove the _ to use
